summary: Map environmental hazards, exposure and vulnerability with QGIS and risk frameworks. Build decision-ready maps and action plans. Explore the course.
lede: Environmental risk mapping combines hazard, exposure and vulnerability evidence to show where sites, assets or receptors may face risk. For environmental officers, GIS analysts and infrastructure planners, it provides a workflow to prepare spatial layers, assess exposure and vulnerability, and compare locations. Learners use QGIS overlays, record data provenance and uncertainty, and produce prioritized maps to support risk-treatment decisions.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who assess where environmental hazards may affect sites, assets, ecosystems or communities and need to communicate spatial priorities.
modules: QGIS Map Reporting and Action Plan
prerequisites: Intermediate-level environmental assessment or planning experience is expected, along with basic map-reading familiarity. No programming is required. Bring a laptop with QGIS installed before the course; the practical exercises use training datasets and do not require a personal software account.
